schema.name: PreviousCycleSeconds
schema.description: Last fully observed production cycle, seconds.

schema.name: BetweenCycleSeconds
schema.description: Live known wait; zero means no active known wait, not proof of uptime.

schema.name: CyclesThisHour
schema.description: Completions in the current local clock hour.

schema.name: CyclesToday
schema.description: Completions in the current local calendar day.

schema.name: DayShiftCurrent
schema.description: Mon–Fri 06:30–17:00; holds until the next scheduled day shift starts.

schema.name: DayShiftPrevious
schema.description: The preceding day shift, copied when its next scheduled shift starts.

schema.name: NightShiftCurrent
schema.description: Mon–Thu 17:00–06:00 next day; holds until the next scheduled night shift starts.

schema.name: NightShiftPrevious
schema.description: The preceding night shift, copied when its next scheduled shift starts.

schema.name: TotalCompleted
schema.description: Accepted complete production cycles since initialization.
